The '''Phase II Dark Trooper''' was the second and main stage of the [[Dark Trooper Project]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Darktrooper2-darkforces.png|left|thumb|Phase II dark trooper intel as acquired by [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Jan Ors]]]]
Each [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was equipped with the external elements such as the suit, a [[jump pack]], and an [[Assault cannon/Legends|assault cannon]] capable of firing 400 [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] shells and 20 missiles before reloading. It was also capable of being loaded into [[Hyperdrive pod/Legends|hyperspace pods]] for transportation. Their [[ARC caster]]s could disable electronics, or boil organic beings alive.

==History==
[[File:Imperial_Dark_Trooper.jpg|left|thumb|A Phase II dark trooper]]
The Phase II dark trooper was intended to be used either as an artificially intelligent droid or exoskeleton&mdash;either way, it was extremely effective in battle. A small number of these soldiers [[Attack on Tak Base|destroyed]] a [[Tak Base|Rebel base]] on [[Talay/Legends|Talay]].

Though most droids were shut down after the destruction of ''[[Arc Hammer]]'', some of these troopers remained in operation throughout the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They would later be seen during the New Republic's [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|attack]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]'', the sound effects of the Dark Troopers were created by [[Clint Bajakian]], who "ring modulated" his own voice, recorded in and out of phase. The dying sound of Dark Trooper II was like this, but mixed with the metallic falling sound of an [[Walker#Imperial_walkers|Imperial walker]] from the [[original trilogy]].<ref name="Dark Forces Official Player's Guide">''[[Dark Forces Official Player's Guide]]''</ref>

In ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]'', these droids can only be created on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] if ''Arc Hammer'' is placed above that specific planet. They were also featured in some of the story missions.
